script.source: def p = doc['metadata.LogDetails.RequestPath.Value']; def m = doc['metadata.LogDetails.RequestMethod']; if (p.size() == 0 || m.size() == 0) return; def norm = /[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}/.matcher(p.value).replaceAll('{id}'); emit(m.value + ' ' + norm);

def p = doc['metadata.LogDetails.RequestPath.Value']; if (p.size() == 0) return; def v = p.value; if (!(v.startsWith('/profile/') || v.startsWith('/notification/') || v.startsWith('/wallet/') || v.startsWith('/schedule/') || v.startsWith('/tratativas/') || v.startsWith('/connections/') || v.startsWith('/resume/') || v.startsWith('/consultant/') || v.startsWith('/services/consultant/'))) return; def m = /[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}/.matcher(v); if (m.find()) { emit(m.group()); }
